item.name: P2-05 AxPut core HTTP and provider review
item.description: Run only against a reviewed disposable transaction/schema. Covers create values/{}, stored-state and overlay edits, retained/destroyed finalization, server-side active conflicts, sequential last-completed-wins behavior, validation, rollback, response omission, and legacy response compatibility. DataObjects use the current StructDef without a stored revision binding.

exec: pm.test('Retained state is reported without a version', () => { pm.expect(body.dataObjectRetained).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('version'); });
